_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Tape and internals sit at the midpoint of the Complacency band with no sustained momentum impulse, so the skilled call is to hold the rung until flows or CVD force a ±1 step.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency; narrative supplies no forward phase or direction (macro commodity print only)
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains range-bound and F&G holds ~45-55 with 30d momentum still pinned near 50
next_move.invalidated_if: Clean range break while ETF flows stay ~0 and CVD suppressed (down to Anxiety) or a liquidity/flow impulse that lifts 30d momentum well off 50 (up to Disbelief)
